Algorithm_Scheme.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Algorithm_Scheme" (
	"Algorithm_Scheme_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Algorithm_Scheme" VARCHAR(20), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Algorithm_Scheme_ID")
)

Algorithm_Type.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Algorithm_Type" (
	"Algorithm_Type_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Algorithm_Name" VARCHAR(30), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Algorithm_Type_ID")
)

Algorithms.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Algorithms" (
	"Algorithm_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Parameters_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Algorithm_Name" VARCHAR(40), 
	"Algorithm_Type_ID" INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Algorithm_ID")
)

Anomalies.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Anomalies" (
	"Anomaly_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Anomaly_Date" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"Anomaly_Cause_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Device_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Configuration_Update_Date" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Anomaly_ID")
)

Anomaly_Causes.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Anomaly_Causes" (
	"Anomaly_Cause_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Anomaly_Cause" VARCHAR(20), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Anomaly_Cause_ID")
)

Device_Configuration.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Device_Configuration" (
	"Device_ID" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"Algorithm_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Tag_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Configuration_Update_Date" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Device_ID", "Configuration_Update_Date")
)

Global_Reports.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Global_Reports" (
	"Creation_Date" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	"Report_ID" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"Report_Name" VARCHAR(100), 
	"Report_Type_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Record_ID" INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Creation_Date", "Report_ID")
)

Log_Journal.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Log_Journal" (
	"Record_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Log_Type_ID" INTEGER, 
	"Record_Date" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	"Anomaly_ID" INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Record_ID")
)

Log_Type.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Log_Type" (
	"Log_Type_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Log_Type" VARCHAR(50), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Log_Type_ID")
)

Parameters.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Parameters" (
	"Parameters_ID" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"Key_Size" INTEGER, 
	"Rounds_Count" INTEGER, 
	"Algorithm_Type_ID" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"Algorithm_Scheme_ID" INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Parameters_ID", "Algorithm_Type_ID")
)

Report_Types.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Report_Types" (
	"Report_Type_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Report_Type" VARCHAR(30), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Report_Type_ID")
)

Sensor_Data.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Sensor_Data" (
	"Record_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Temperature" NUMERIC(5, 2), 
	"Humidity" NUMERIC(5, 2), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Record_ID")
)

Tag_Journal.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Tag_Journal" (
	"Tag_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Tag_Name" VARCHAR(30), 
	"Creation_Date" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("Tag_ID")
)

Users.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Users" (
	"User_ID" SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	"Username" VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	"Email" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	"Password_Hash" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	"Role" VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	"Is_Active" BOOLEAN, 
	"Created_At" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("User_ID"), 
	UNIQUE ("Username"), 
	UNIQUE ("Email")
)

mqtt_replay_state.sql:
CREATE TABLE mqtt_replay_state (
	consumer VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	key_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (consumer, device_id, key_epoch), 
	CHECK (last_sequence > 0 AND key_epoch > 0)
)
